full_text: Worse part of #covid19 for me: missing the serenity of Clagett Farm. This is a throwback collage from summer harvests past. #safetyfirst #quarantinelife @ Prince George's County, Maryland https://t.co/QRLIbn7hpE
image_caption: a collage of photos of various vegetables and fruits
location_description: Rosaryville is an unincorporated area and census-designated place (CDP) in Prince George's County, Maryland, United States, located south of Cinton and Upper Marlboro beside U.S. Route 301. Per the 2020 census, the population was 11,548. including housing developments and rural open space.
